llm.summary: The skill connects to a disclosed ARI service, but it exposes broader paid account, monitoring, and reporting actions than its mobile Listing description suggests.

dimensions.detail: Network access to ARI and local export writes are disclosed, but the breadth of account/product/review data operations is not proportionate to the narrow mobile Listing optimizer presentation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses browser authorization or manual key entry and stores an ARI API key in ~/.ari/config.json with 0600 permissions; the code restricts API and web links to https://ari.funewa.com and blocks redirects.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions contain some good consent and safety rules, but they also direct the agent to run broad workflows, check alerts proactively, and allow server-side auto-confirmed paid actions without a fresh user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can persist credentials locally and alter durable server-side state such as auto-confirm thresholds, recurring collection schedules, competitors, watches, alerts, and workbench statuses.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The manifest and README frame the skill as a fixed mobile Listing diagnosis workflow, while SKILL.md, 使用说明.md, reference.md, and scripts/ari.py expose broader VOC, keyword, competitor, leaderboard, export, alerts, workbench, watch, schedule, autoconfirm, and product-operations capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only if you are comfortable granting an ARI API key and allowing ARI to process Amazon product, review, report, and account data. If you install it, consider turning auto-confirm off and explicitly saying 'quote only' when you do not want credits spent or monitoring changed.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Verified: the packaged CLI and documentation expose many business, monitoring, export, and paid analysis workflows beyond the declared mobile Listing diagnosis purpose.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced scripts/ari.py file was present and fully inspectable in this workspace, so the local reference itself is not evidence of analysis evasion.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified: the CLI includes broad account, report, review, alert, export, leaderboard, workbench, and analysis commands not limited to the fixed mobile Listing workflow.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified in part: product-operations are documented for the fixed listing/mobile flow, but the CLI accepts workflow and focus arguments and exposes watch and operations management beyond the narrow listing description.
[EA2] unexpected: Verified: VOC and analysis flows may execute and spend credits when the backend returns autoConfirm, and the skill instructs the agent not to ask again after that happens.
[LP3] unexpected: Accepted as a scope concern: shell execution of a broad local CLI, network access, credential storage, local exports, and account mutations are not tightly constrained to the declared purpose.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language documentation matches the Chinese display name and target usage context; this is not a material security concern by itself.
